subject: gk
question: What are Guyots?

options.text: It is a flat topped seamount.
These are deep valleys, some comparable to the Grand Canyon.
It is a mountain with pointed summits.
These are low islands found in the tropical oceans consisting of coral reefs.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a flat-topped seamount**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• These flat summits could be more than 10 kilometers in circumference.
 
• The Swiss-American geologist Arnold Henry Guyot is the source of the name.
 
• According to research, guyots are volcanic islands that form at the shallow crests of mid-oceanic ridges and rise.
 
• The islands are trimmed off by wave erosion both during and right after their development.
 
• The seafloor moves laterally away from ridge or rise crests at rates of several centimeters per year, according to the widely recognized idea of seafloor spreading.
 
• Guyots gradually plunge deeper as the seafloor spreads away from the crests and sinks at the same time.
 
• The majority of summits in the Pacific Ocean, where guyots are most prevalent, are between 1,000 and 2,000 meters below sea level.
